sources: Palestinian news agency Wafa, via Al Jazeera Nov 4 liveblog
fault_line: Security sweep or collective pressure -- what distinguishes a 34-person dawn raid from routine West Bank operations?

sections.what_happened: Israeli forces detained at least 34 Palestinians during widespread raids: 18 in the Nablus governorate (including two women; four brothers arrested in al-Ma'ajin; detentions in Beita, Kafr Qallil, Yatma, Zeita Jamma'in, Zawata) and 16 in the Hebron governorate. Houses were raided and searched; a young woman was among those detained in Beita; nine arrested in Zeita Jamma'in.
sections.what_verified: 1 declared family: WAFA (T3, STATE PS). AJ is the relay, not independent corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: No IDF statement or arrest rationale in the entry; detainee identities and charges unreported.
